mapper.select: SELECT l.loanId AS loanId, m.memberId AS memberId, m.name AS memberName, r.title AS resourceTitle, l.resourceId AS resourceId, l.loanDate AS loanDate FROM loans l JOIN members m ON l.memberId = m.memberId JOIN resources r ON l.resourceId = r.resourceId WHERE m.memberId = #{memberId} ORDER BY loanDate
